title: Restriction identity for the cyclic universal-section map
statement: Let $h:Y\to X$ be a morphism of schemes and $e,q\in\mathbf N$. Let $P(W)=\operatorname{Hom}_{D^+(Y)}((h^*\mathbf Z[W])[0],\mathbf Z/e_Y[0][q])$ with restriction by precomposition, and write $C_W$ for the explicitly constructed cyclic map of [def-sbc-abelian-representable-cohomology-map]. For any arrow $v:V\to W$ on $X_{et}$, let $g:Y\times_X V\to Y\times_X W$ be its base change. For every $\xi\in P(W)$, applying cohomology pullback along $g$ to $C_W(\xi)$, then applying the canonical coefficient isomorphism $g^*(\mathbf Z/e)\cong\mathbf Z/e$, equals $C_V(P(v)(\xi))$.

proof.text: Apply the abelian representable comparison naturality theorem to the coefficient sheaf Y.constantZMod e.
Apply cyclic coefficient pullback compatibility to the resulting comparison class.
Unfold cyclicRepresentableCohomologyMap and identify the displayed compositions by definitional equality.

mathlib_searches.query: Cohomology of a sheaf restricted to an etale object is Ext from the free abelian sheaf on the representable
Derived Hom from the free abelian sheaf on an etale representable computes cohomology of the restricted sheaf naturally under restriction
Ext of a free abelian representable sheaf equals derived evaluation on a localized site; CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext, Function.Bijective; mapExtUnit|extAddEquiv|uliftYonedaEquiv
mathlib_searches.results: LeanFinder returns Sheaf.H, cohomologyPresheafFunctor and generic Ext/resolution APIs; Loogle returns mk₀_bijective and mapExt bijections, not representable-restriction comparison. Local source reading finds the general free-sheaf and sections constructions in EtaleOpenCohomologyComparison and the exact Ext adjunction in MapBijective; the former are reused. Open-object cohomology comparison requires an open immersion and does not apply to a general etale W. The latter still needs the representable isomorphism and identification of its unit with the explicit generator.
